entries.name: Amo hover button
entries.when: A pill button that plays a short bundled clip of its label puffing into glossy 3D letters on hover; not for mini-apps: it is amo's trade dress and hover-only.

entries.name: Apple's corners
entries.when: True superellipse corners for a button or card via clip-path; use where the Air pill radius still shows a kink, one shape per element.

entries.name: Arcade pixel
entries.when: A word drawn tiny and blown up so each pixel becomes a big square, rendered in WebGL; not for mini-apps, WebGL is non-lite and the study is excluded.

entries.name: Chromatic glow
entries.when: Soft light bloom that splits into colour fringes at the edges, a WebGL post effect; not for mini-apps, WebGL is non-lite and the study is excluded.

entries.name: Dia Browser's gradient
entries.when: A bottom-of-screen glow of blurred colour bars that grows up on load; not for mini-apps, it reproduces Dia Browser's identity and is a full-screen background.

entries.name: Fade motion
entries.when: A headline motion-blurred by stacking hundreds of faint copies on the GPU; not for mini-apps, WebGL is non-lite and the study is excluded.

entries.name: Figma vector editor
entries.when: Figma-style selection chrome: thin blue box, corner handles, size tag and draggable bezier points; not for mini-apps, it is Figma's trade dress.

entries.name: Ghosty reveal
entries.when: Mask-image wipe that lets a photo bleed in through a soft cloudy edge; use for one hero image or gallery reveal per screen, mask asset bundled.

entries.name: Holo
entries.when: Holographic foil card that tilts with a finger drag or device orientation; use once per screen for a ticket, pass or profile hero.

entries.name: Kinetic typography
entries.when: A hero letter or short word sliced into tiles that ripple on independent sine waves; the single hero motion on a title screen, never body copy.

entries.name: Liquid UI
entries.when: SDF-driven liquid silhouettes that fuse neighbouring cards with an inward bend; a decorative group background behind a card cluster, not layout.

entries.name: Midjourney Medical's ASCII
entries.when: Loose letters spin and settle into a wordmark as live text on load; not for mini-apps, it reproduces the Midjourney Medical identity.

entries.name: Pixel brushes
entries.when: Canvas 2D brush that stamps a small shape along the finger's path, from crisp line to loose spray; use for a doodle, signature or guestbook sketch.

entries.name: Ransom note
entries.when: Type with real cut-out magazine letters taped down crooked; not for mini-apps as published, the letter imagery is site-hosted and was never captured.

entries.name: Realistic emboss
entries.when: Realistic embossed lettering with directional light, rendered in WebGL; not for mini-apps, WebGL is non-lite and the study is excluded.

entries.name: Symbols effect
entries.when: GPU filter that cuts an image or live video into four brightness bands stamped with tinted symbols; not for mini-apps, GPU-only makes it non-lite.

entries.name: The art of color depth
entries.when: Ten layered-light CSS materials (glossy, glass, metal, cushion) for buttons; use on the one primary action of a screen, never on every control.

entries.name: The typer
entries.when: Eased typing where a wave flickers each letter through pill, highlight and outline states before landing; for one headline or status line.

entries.name: Animated Content
entries.when: A block that fades and slides in from a chosen side on mount; reach for Air's --slide-in for a panel's first paint and never tie the entrance to scroll.

entries.name: Antigravity
entries.when: A 3D particle field that scatters away from the mouse cursor; a desktop pointer toy with no finger equivalent and no place inside Messages.

entries.name: Blob Cursor
entries.when: A gooey blob that trails the mouse pointer with inertia; there is no pointer on a phone, so it has no use in a mini-app.

entries.name: Click Spark
entries.when: A short burst of sparks where the finger taps; use it once for the confirming tap (RSVP sent, item added), never as ambient decoration.

entries.name: Crosshair
entries.when: A custom crosshair cursor that tracks the mouse and reacts to links; replacing the cursor means nothing on touch.

entries.name: Cubes
entries.when: A small cluster of CSS cubes turning slowly as a hero object; compose it from fancy/css-box, auto-rotating, with hover as an optional extra and never the only input.

entries.name: Cursor Grid
entries.when: A canvas grid whose cells glow under the pointer or finger and pulse on tap; the Kit's pixel-trail already does this, so use that.

entries.name: Elastic Mesh
entries.when: A full-surface spring mesh that stretches under the pointer and settles; a hover physics playground, inert under a thumb and too heavy for a card.

entries.name: Electric Border
entries.when: A crackling electric outline around one card; use it for the single live or pending item and fall back to a steady glow under lite or reduced motion.

entries.name: Fade Content
entries.when: A block that fades or slides in once it scrolls into view; nothing reveals on scroll inside Messages, so use Air's --slide-in on mount instead.

entries.name: Ghost Cursor
entries.when: A translucent trail that follows the mouse cursor; cursor followers do not exist on touch and are out of scope for a mini-app.

entries.name: Glare Hover
entries.when: A light glare sweeping across a card on hover; rebuild it as a one-shot CSS sweep on press or on mount, since hover never reveals on touch.

entries.name: Glow Cursor
entries.when: A shader light trail drawn behind the mouse pointer; WebGL, cursor-bound and non-lite, so it is not for a mini-app.

entries.name: Gradual Blur
entries.when: Content that un-blurs from soft to sharp on a trigger. Build it as a one-shot mount reveal (filter: blur to 0 in 300ms), never scroll-driven; sharp from the start under reduced motion.

entries.name: Halftone Reveal
entries.when: Halftone dot screen over an image that sharpens where the pointer is. Not used: a hover-revealed image is a hover-only affordance and there is no cursor in Messages.

entries.name: Image Trail
entries.when: Images that spawn and fade along the pointer's path. Not used: cursor-following decoration has no meaning on a 390px touch card; show photos with fancy/simple-carousel.

entries.name: Laser Flow
entries.when: A laser beam that pours light onto a surface behind a hero title. One per screen as the hero motion of a launch or game landing; a flat gradient plate under lite and reduced motion.

entries.name: Logo Loop
entries.when: Endless strip of logos with seamless repeat and pause on hover. Already covered by fancy/simple-marquee, which takes logos, photos or words and pauses under reduced motion.

entries.name: Magic Rings
entries.when: Concentric glowing rings that ripple as the pointer moves. Build it: a few SVG circles with a stroke pulse fired by a tap; rings sit still under reduced motion.

entries.name: Magnet
entries.when: A button that leans toward the cursor and springs back. Not used: there is no cursor in Messages; a 44px target with a press state is the touch affordance.

entries.name: Magnet Lines
entries.when: A grid of short lines that rotate to point at the cursor. Not used: cursor-following decoration with no touch equivalent, and hundreds of nodes for a 390px card.

entries.name: Meta Balls
entries.when: Soft blobs that merge and split as they drift. Already covered: arlan/liquid-ui merges card silhouettes and fancy/gooey-svg-filter goos any animated circles, both without WebGL.

entries.name: Metallic Paint
entries.when: Liquid chrome shimmer filling an SVG logo or word. Already covered by libraries/metal-fx, which renders a flat plate when WebGL, lite or reduced motion is off.

entries.name: Noise
entries.when: Film-grain overlay that gives a flat canvas some texture. Build it: SVG feTurbulence as a static tile at low opacity; animate only in atmosphere and only as aria-hidden decoration.

entries.name: Orbit Images
entries.when: Images that travel around a custom SVG path. Already covered: fancy/circling-elements orbits avatars or badges around a center, and fancy/text-along-path handles arbitrary paths.

entries.name: Pixel Swap
entries.when: A grid of pixel blocks covers a card, the content swaps underneath, and the blocks dissolve. Build it as a CSS grid with staggered opacity for a tap-to-flip card or a confirmation swap.

entries.name: Pixel Trail
entries.when: Squares light up and fade behind the pointer for a retro digital feel; use fancy/pixel-trail instead, which does the same under a finger on a 2D canvas and stays lite.

entries.name: Pixel Transition
entries.when: A pixel-grid dissolve swaps one face of a card for another on tap: a photo to its caption, a price to its detail. One per screen; both faces ship in the bundle.

entries.name: Ribbons
entries.when: Physics ribbons stream behind the pointer; there is no pointer in Messages and the layer is empty at rest, so the Kit does not use it.

entries.name: Ripple Distortion
entries.when: A water-displacement shader warps an image under the pointer and trails a wake; a pointer-following distortion on a WebGL canvas has no place in a touch-only, lite-first card.

entries.name: Scroll Expand
entries.when: A rounded media frame grows to full bleed as the page scrolls; nothing moves on scroll inside the webview, so the Kit does not use it. Use a full-bleed .hero from the start.

entries.name: Shape Blur
entries.when: A blurred geometric outline morphs toward the pointer on hover; hover-only and Three-rendered, it fails touch-first and lite. For an ambient blob use fancy/animated-gradient-with-svg.

entries.name: Splash Cursor
entries.when: A fluid-simulation splash bursts under the cursor and curls into waves; a full-page cursor effect on WebGL is off-limits in Messages.

entries.name: Star Border
entries.when: A sparkle border orbits a button to mark the one action that matters; libraries/border-beam already does this around a card or CTA, so use it and keep it to one per screen.

entries.name: Sticker Peel
entries.when: A sticker whose corner lifts and peels when you tap or drag it: a 'going' badge on an RSVP, a 'confirmed' seal on a receipt. One per screen; the image lives in the bundle.

entries.name: Strands
entries.when: Glowing strands ripple and weave behind a landing hero; build it as a few translucent Canvas 2D curves so it stays lite, and reach for packed Beams or Silk only when a recipe wants the shader look.

entries.name: Swarm Cursor
entries.when: A flocking particle swarm chases the pointer and scatters at rest; a cursor-following WebGL layer has no role on a touch-only card in Messages.

entries.name: Target Cursor
entries.when: Four corner brackets replace the mouse cursor and snap onto hovered targets; Messages has no cursor, so the Kit does not use it. Use a focus ring on the .item instead.

entries.name: Acid Squares
entries.when: A square tunnel receding into depth behind a title; build it as concentric squares scaling in Canvas 2D for a game title screen, not as a page-wide shader.

entries.name: Aero Shards
entries.when: A 3D field of folded foil shards drifting behind a landing or product hero; non-lite, one per app, flat plate under lite and reduced motion.

entries.name: Aurora
entries.when: Slow ribbons of color flowing behind a headline; use fancy/animated-gradient-with-svg in aurora tones instead of a shader.

entries.name: Balatro
entries.when: The swirling paint shader from the game Balatro; it reproduces another product's identity, so it stays out of every mini-app.

entries.name: Ballpit
entries.when: A 3D physics ball pit filling the page; too heavy and too playful for a 390px card in Messages, so it stays out.

entries.name: Beams
entries.when: Crossing light ribbons behind a landing or product hero; compiled from the restricted artifact, non-lite, one per app.

entries.name: Color Bends
entries.when: Bands of vivid color bending and flowing behind a panel; use fancy/animated-gradient-with-svg, or Grainient from the restricted set for the richer look.

entries.name: CRT Warp
entries.when: A curved CRT plasma with scanlines and bloom for a retro game title screen; non-lite, one per app, flat frame under reduced motion, pointer part off.

entries.name: Dark Veil
entries.when: A barely moving dark haze behind a chat or tool screen; the atmosphere canvas with fancy/animated-gradient-with-svg in dark tones already gives it.

entries.name: Dither
entries.when: Retro dithered noise drifting behind a pixel-styled hero or 2D game; compiled from the restricted artifact, non-lite, one per app.

entries.name: Dot Field
entries.when: A dot grid that bulges and sparkles under the cursor; on touch use fancy/pixel-trail, and a plain dot grid is one CSS radial-gradient.

entries.name: Dot Grid
entries.when: A dot grid that shoves away from the cursor; on touch use fancy/pixel-trail, and a still dot grid is one CSS radial-gradient.

entries.name: Evil Eye
entries.when: A single animated eye with a slit pupil and fiery glow as a hero mark; draw it in SVG with a dilating pupil and one glow, one per screen.

entries.name: Faulty Terminal
entries.when: Flickering CRT terminal squares behind a status or retro game screen; compiled from the restricted artifact, non-lite, one per app.

entries.name: Ferrofluid
entries.when: Churning fluid drawn as glowing contour lines behind a landing hero; non-lite, one per app, cursor magnet off or bound to a drag.

entries.name: Floating Lines
entries.when: Three.js lines that drift and bend toward the cursor; skip it in a mini-app, since Messages has no cursor and the packed Beams background already gives ambient light lines.

entries.name: Galaxy
entries.when: Twinkling starfield behind a launch countdown or night-event hero; one per app, aria-hidden, never under lite, with pointer parallax switched off.

entries.name: Ghost Fibers
entries.when: Deep-blue twisting fiber field with glowing bands; a calm atmospheric backdrop for a landing hero or evening invite when the packed Silk and Beams feel too plain.

entries.name: Gradient Blinds
entries.when: Bold diagonal gradient stripes behind a store or landing hero when a flat token gradient feels too quiet; the pointer spotlight means nothing on touch, so leave it out.

entries.name: Gradient Waves
entries.when: Stacked sine waves rolling toward a hazy horizon; a calm hero backdrop for a landing or countdown screen where the slow roll is the only motion, flat and still under lite.

entries.name: Grainient
entries.when: Grainy swirling gradient with soft wave distortion; the packed painterly backdrop for a landing or store hero with one display line over it.

entries.name: Grid Distortion
entries.when: An image whose mesh warps under the cursor; skip it in a mini-app, since the distortion exists only while a pointer moves and Messages has no pointer.

entries.name: Grid Motion
entries.when: Rows of tiles that slide with the pointer's position; skip it in a mini-app, since there is no pointer on touch and a drifting wall of tiles fights the single column.

entries.name: Grid Scan
entries.when: A perspective grid room with one light plane sweeping through it; the hero backdrop for a retro game or tool screen, with the sweep as the screen's single hero motion.

entries.name: Hyperspeed
entries.when: Light streaks racing at the viewer, faster while held; skip it in a mini-app, since it is a heavy full-page Three scene with bloom and the hold gesture collides with iOS long-press.

entries.name: Iridescence
entries.when: Pearlescent shader with slow shifting waves; the packed glossy backdrop for a product or store hero that wants a material feel behind a single display line.

entries.name: Letter Glitch
entries.when: Matrix-style grid of glyphs flickering on a 2D canvas; build an original for a terminal-themed game or tool backdrop, in the system mono font, finite and aria-hidden.

entries.name: Light Pillar
entries.when: One glowing vertical column of light behind a headline or countdown number; use it when a hero needs a focal glow without a shader, flat and unblurred under lite.

entries.name: Light Rays
entries.when: Volumetric rays falling from a chosen edge; the packed backdrop for a confirmation or reveal hero where light from above is the only motion on the screen.

entries.name: Light Tunnel
entries.when: Radial strands converging to a vanishing point with pulses racing inward; a loud launch or game hero backdrop, one pulse cycle as the hero motion, still under reduced motion.

entries.name: Lightfall
entries.when: A tunnel of colored light streaks raining toward the viewer; use once as the splash hero of a game-3d or launch screen when Beams and Light Rays feel too calm.

entries.name: Lightning
entries.when: A branching lightning bolt with glow flicker; strike once as the hero moment of a storm, power-up or countdown-hits-zero screen, never as a permanent flashing loop.

entries.name: Line Waves
entries.when: Stacked sine lines that ripple across a panel with a slow color shift; use as a calm ambient header behind a title when a gradient blob feels too soft.

entries.name: Liquid Chrome
entries.when: A flowing chrome surface behind a hero word or product; import @kit/restricted/liquid-chrome for one non-lite hero, or reach for libraries/metal-fx when you need Tier A.

entries.name: Liquid Ether
entries.when: Fluid color that swirls under a finger and drifts on its own; import @kit/restricted/liquid-ether for a non-lite landing hero that invites a touch.

entries.name: Molten Metal
entries.when: Molten plasma filaments with white-hot cores; import @kit/restricted/molten-metal for a dramatic non-lite game or launch hero, one per app.

entries.name: Orb
entries.when: A glowing energy orb that warps under the pointer; the Kit already has aicss/orbs for an ambient presence and libraries/thinking-orbs for named states, so use those.

entries.name: Particles
entries.when: A field of drifting dots behind a hero or empty state; draw a few dozen on Canvas 2D at DPR 1, aria-hidden, and stop them under reduced motion.

entries.name: Pixel Blast
entries.when: Chunky pixel bursts that ripple out from a tap; rebuild on Canvas 2D as tap feedback in a game or a one-shot celebration when a form confirms.

entries.name: Pixel Snow
entries.when: Pixelated snow drifting down behind a card; rebuild on Canvas 2D for a seasonal invite or countdown, aria-hidden, frozen to a still scatter under reduced motion.

entries.name: Plasma
entries.when: Soft plasma gradients that swirl and morph; fancy/animated-gradient-with-svg gives the same ambient wash in lite CSS, and packed Grainient or Silk give the shader look.

entries.name: Plasma Wave
entries.when: Raymarched plasma sheets with two interfering waves; a non-lite hero for a game-3d or launch screen when Molten Metal and Silk are already spoken for.

entries.name: Prism
entries.when: A rotating glass prism throwing colored light; import @kit/restricted/prism as the one non-lite hero of a landing or store screen.

entries.name: Prismatic Burst
entries.when: Rainbow rays bursting from a center point; rebuild as a slowly rotating CSS conic-gradient sunburst under a radial mask for a celebration or reveal hero.

entries.name: Radar
entries.when: Concentric rings, spokes and a sweeping beam; rebuild in SVG with a rotating conic-gradient wedge as the searching state of a status or chat screen.

entries.name: Ripple Grid
entries.when: A grid whose lines ripple outward in slow rings; an ambient backdrop for one hero screen of a tool or game lobby, never behind body copy.

entries.name: Scanner
entries.when: Soft interference bands sweep the panel like an oscilloscope trace; use as the ambient plate behind a working or scanning status, one per screen.

entries.name: Shape Grid
entries.when: A field of small squares, hexagons, circles or triangles drifting in one direction; a quiet decorative plate behind a hero card or lobby.

entries.name: Shape Waves
entries.when: Rows of tiny shapes brighten and swell as waves roll across them, optionally parting around a word; a hero plate for a landing or launch card.

entries.name: Side Rays
entries.when: Light rays fanning in from one edge behind a hero word or product shot; already packed as @kit/restricted/side-rays, non-lite, flat plate when off.

entries.name: Silk
entries.when: Slow silk-like waves with soft lighting behind a hero; already packed as @kit/restricted/silk, non-lite, renders a flat gradient when WebGL is off.

entries.name: Sliced Waves
entries.when: A row of soft glowing bars that ripple like an equalizer; an ambient plate for a music, playlist or listening-party card, one per screen.

entries.name: Soft Aurora
entries.when: Slow aurora-like color drift behind a panel; reach for fancy/animated-gradient-with-svg, or a packed shader gradient (Grainient, Silk) when non-lite.

entries.name: Threads
entries.when: Fine wavy lines that sway like woven fabric; an ambient plate behind a hero headline, drawn once as a still under reduced motion.

entries.name: Topography
entries.when: Glowing contour lines that slowly breathe like a living elevation map; a hero plate for a trip, hike, route or map-flavored card.

entries.name: Waves
entries.when: Layered flowing lines with a gentle swell; a calm ambient plate behind a hero card, one per screen and still under reduced motion.

entries.name: Web Threads
entries.when: Glowing sine threads converging on a bright focal point; a hero plate for a launch or landing card that wants one luminous center.

entries.name: Accordion Gallery
entries.when: Hover-widening panels that reveal parallax imagery and captions; not for a mini-app, hover never reveals and there is no cursor to parallax, so a gallery uses fancy/simple-carousel.

entries.name: Animated List
entries.when: List rows that enter with a short stagger on mount; use it once as the hero motion when a guest list or task list first appears, never on scroll.

entries.name: Border Glow
entries.when: A glowing border that chases the cursor; the Kit's border-beam already marks the one card that deserves attention without needing a pointer.

entries.name: Bounce Cards
entries.when: A fan of cards that springs into place on mount; a hero motion for a gallery or product spread, settling to the same fanned layout under reduced motion.

entries.name: Bubble Menu
entries.when: A round toggle that expands into a staggered ring of action bubbles; use for a compact plus-menu of three to five actions, opened by tap.

entries.name: Card Nav
entries.when: A header that expands into card panels of grouped links; rarely needed inside Messages, where one screen and header.bar carry navigation, build as a plain disclosure if a landing needs it.

entries.name: Card Swap
entries.when: A small stack of cards where the front card drops to the back on a timer; a testimonial or feature rotator for a landing, paused to the front card under reduced motion.

entries.name: Carousel
entries.when: Swipeable carousel with loop and snap; fancy/simple-carousel is the gallery default and already covers it.

entries.name: Chroma Grid
entries.when: Grayscale tiles that regain color under a cursor spotlight; not for a mini-app, hover never reveals and the backdrop-filter overlay is non-lite, use an Air .grid of .tile.

entries.name: Circular Gallery
entries.when: WebGL ring of bent images you drag to spin; a gallery on a phone uses fancy/simple-carousel, since lite forbids WebGL and the fallback is the carousel anyway.

entries.name: Counter
entries.when: Digits that roll to a value with easing; fancy/basic-number-ticker already counts RSVP totals, prices and countdowns.

entries.name: Curved Input
entries.when: An input bent along an arc with a fake caret; not for a mini-app, inputs stay native 16px controls, and decorative arc text is fancy/text-along-path.

entries.name: Decay Card
entries.when: A card whose image displaces and dissolves as the pointer moves; not for a mini-app, there is no cursor to drive it and hover never carries meaning.

entries.name: Depth Carousel
entries.when: Coverflow-style rail where cards recede into perspective as you drag; build with CSS 3D on top of simple-carousel's snap when a product spread needs depth.

entries.name: Dock
entries.when: Icon bar that magnifies items near the cursor; not for a mini-app, proximity scaling has no touch equivalent and it recreates Apple's dock, use a 44px tab row.

entries.name: Dome Gallery
entries.when: Photos wrapped on a draggable 3D dome as a full-screen showpiece; on a 390px card use the gallery recipe's simple-carousel, or css-box for six faces.

entries.name: Drift Wall
entries.when: An endless perspective wall of tiles drifting past as ambient decor behind a hero; the Kit's simple-marquee tilted with a CSS perspective does the same job.

entries.name: Elastic Slider
entries.when: A range slider whose thumb overshoots and springs back on release; use for one tunable value (tip, quantity, budget) where the flourish confirms the drop.

entries.name: Flowing Menu
entries.when: A highlight that slides between tabs or menu rows as the active item changes; use for segmented controls and small nav, never as a hover reveal.

entries.name: Fluid Glass
entries.when: A Three.js lens that refracts the page under a pointer-following glass blob; a desktop showpiece with no place inside a 390px lite card.

entries.name: Flying Posters
entries.when: Posters on a WebGL ribbon that spin as the page scrolls; scroll-linked motion is forbidden in the webview, so it has no mini-app use.

entries.name: Folder
entries.when: A folder icon that opens on tap to fan out two or three cards; a playful disclosure for a small photo set or the items an agent gathered.

entries.name: Glass Icons
entries.when: Frosted-glass icon tiles for a feature row or action grid; on Air use the color-depth glass material so lite surfaces get layered gradients, not blur.

entries.name: Glass Surface
entries.when: A refractive glass panel with edge lighting; Air's .panel with var(--blur) is the glass in atmosphere, and pixel or lite render it flat.

entries.name: Gooey Nav
entries.when: A tab thumb that stretches like liquid and splits into droplets as it moves to the tapped item; use liquid-gooey, one nav per screen.

entries.name: Infinite Menu
entries.when: A menu of items that wraps endlessly as you drag or swipe; on a phone a snap carousel or a wrapping chip row covers it without the WebGL sphere.

entries.name: Infinite Spiral
entries.when: Images on an endlessly turning 3D helix as a hero gallery; heavy, non-lite, and covered on a phone by simple-carousel or css-box.

entries.name: Lanyard
entries.when: A badge card swinging on a physics-simulated lanyard; three, rapier and GLB assets make it a desktop showcase, not a Messages card.

entries.name: Line Sidebar
entries.when: A sidebar list whose items shift toward the cursor; there is no cursor in Messages and no sidebar in a single column, so skip it.

entries.name: Magic Bento
entries.when: A bento grid of tiles with tap-to-expand; build it from Air's .grid and .tile and drop the cursor spotlight, glow and magnetism that need a mouse.

entries.name: Masonry
entries.when: Two-column grid of mixed-height photo tiles that settle into place once on load; the gallery grid when images vary in shape, never a layout for text.

entries.name: Model Viewer
entries.when: Orbitable Three.js viewer for a 3D model file; not for Messages, where the model is a remote asset, WebGL is off under lite and the card is 390px wide.

entries.name: Morph Slider
entries.when: Hero image slider that melts one photo into the next through a displacement shader; one per landing or product hero, a plain crossfade or still under lite.

entries.name: Option Wheel
entries.when: Curved drum picker you drag to choose one value from a short list; use it when the pick is the screen's hero, otherwise reach for a native select.

entries.name: Pill Nav
entries.when: Row of pills with a highlight that slides to the active one; the section switcher for a tool or page app with two to four sections.

entries.name: Pixel Card
entries.when: Card whose surface fills with animated pixel squares as it appears; a once-on-mount reveal for one featured card, triggered by mount or tap, never hover.

entries.name: Profile Card
entries.when: Portrait card with a glare that tilts in 3D; the host or artist card at the top of a landing screen, one per screen, built on holo.

entries.name: Reflective Card
entries.when: Card that mirrors the viewer's webcam and glares with the cursor; needs camera permission and a mouse, neither of which Messages gives you.

entries.name: Scroll Stack
entries.when: Cards that pin and pile up as the page scrolls; a scroll-linked landing section the Kit only allows as sticky stacking-cards, never as JS driven by scroll position.

entries.name: Specular Button
entries.when: Glass button with a bright rim light sweeping its edge; the one primary action on a screen, drawn with border-beam over a color-depth glass material.

entries.name: Spotlight Card
entries.when: Card lit by a gradient spotlight under the cursor; there is no cursor in Messages, and a still highlight is a two-line CSS glow the Builder writes inline.

entries.name: Stack
entries.when: Deck of cards you swipe to send the top one to the back; a gallery or guest-photo hero when a flat horizontal carousel is not enough.

entries.name: Staggered Menu
entries.when: Overlay menu whose items slide in one after another on open; the nav for a multi-section page or tool app, opened from the header bar.

entries.name: Stepper
entries.when: Multi-step form with a progress indicator and animated step changes; use it for RSVP, checkout and any form longer than one compact card.

entries.name: Tilted Card
entries.when: Card that tilts in perspective toward the pointer; on a phone use holo, which tilts with device orientation and adds the foil only if you want it.

entries.name: ASCII Text
entries.when: Hero word drawn as animated ASCII glyphs for a retro terminal feel; a game or lo-fi title, one per screen, using the bundled monospace, still glyphs under reduced motion.

entries.name: Blur Text
entries.when: Headline or confirmation line that resolves from soft blur to crisp, word by word; a one-shot mount reveal for the hero, never for body copy.

entries.name: Circular Text
entries.when: Short label set around a circle with a slow spin; a decorative badge or stamp beside a hero. Already fancy/text-along-path.

entries.name: Count Up
entries.when: A number that counts to its value with formatting and decimals: totals, prices, guest counts. Already fancy/basic-number-ticker.

entries.name: Curved Loop
entries.when: Phrase that loops along an SVG curve and can be dragged; a decorative band under a hero. fancy/text-along-path plus fancy/simple-marquee cover it.

entries.name: Decrypted Text
entries.when: Label that cycles random glyphs before resolving to real text, once on mount or on view. Already fancy/scramble-in (fancy/scramble-hover for hover).

entries.name: Depth Text
entries.when: Extruded layered type whose parallax follows the pointer; there is no pointer in Messages, so write the static extrusion as text-shadow and skip the motion.

entries.name: Echo Text
entries.when: Ghosted copies converge and settle into one hero word; a single mount entrance for a title, static word under reduced motion.

entries.name: Falling Text
entries.when: Letters drop and bounce into a headline as a playful entrance for a game or party app; one per screen, letters already landed under reduced motion.

entries.name: Fold Text
entries.when: Lines unfold into place like creased paper; a one-shot hero entrance for a two or three line title, flat lines under reduced motion.

entries.name: Fuzzy Text
entries.when: Word that vibrates with a fuzzy edge on a small canvas; decorative game title or lo-fi hero, aria-hidden, crisp text under reduced motion.

entries.name: Glitch Text
entries.when: RGB-split jitter over a hero word or game title; a short finite CSS glitch, never on status or body text, still under reduced motion.

entries.name: Gradient Text
entries.when: Headline with a colour gradient sweeping across the glyphs; one hero word or CTA per screen, gradient held still under reduced motion.

entries.name: Masked Heading
entries.when: Large headline with a drifting gradient (or bundled image) showing through the glyphs, revealed word by word; a landing hero, flat gradient under lite or reduced motion.

entries.name: Particle Text
entries.when: Hero word that assembles from drifting particles and scatters again on tap; a Canvas 2D moment for a reveal or game title, assembled text under reduced motion.

entries.name: Rotating Text
entries.when: Slot in a headline that cycles phrases with a flip transition. Already fancy/text-rotate.

entries.name: Scrambled Text
entries.when: Text that distorts around the cursor; there is no cursor in Messages, so skip it and unscramble a label once on mount with fancy/scramble-in.

entries.name: Scroll Float
entries.when: Text that drifts and parallax-shifts as the page scrolls; nothing moves on scroll inside the webview, so give a hero a gentle idle drift with fancy/float instead.

entries.name: Scroll Reveal
entries.when: Words unblur and rise as they scroll into place; scroll-linked reveals are forbidden, so reveal the headline once on mount with fancy/vertical-cut-reveal.

entries.name: Scroll Velocity
entries.when: A marquee whose speed and skew follow scroll velocity; scroll may not drive motion here, so run a constant strip with fancy/simple-marquee.

entries.name: Shiny Text
entries.when: A sheen that sweeps across a word or label; use it for a thinking line or one hero word, never on body copy or on more than one element per screen.

entries.name: Shuffle
entries.when: Characters shuffle before settling into a short label; fancy/scramble-in already does this once on mount for a kicker, a price or a status word.

entries.name: Split Flap Text
entries.when: A departure board that clacks through phrases tile by tile; the hero for a countdown, a guest count or an event status when fancy/text-rotate feels too soft.

entries.name: Split Text
entries.when: A headline whose words or letters enter with a stagger; fancy/vertical-cut-reveal is the Kit's version, run once on mount as the screen's hero motion.

entries.name: Stroke Text
entries.when: Outlined letters draw themselves on and then fill; a one-shot hero for a confirmation or a launch headline on a screen with no other motion.

entries.name: Text Cursor
entries.when: Copies of a word trail the cursor; Messages has no cursor and a drag scrolls the card, so leave it out (fancy/pixel-trail is the finger-safe trail if one is wanted).

entries.name: Text Loop
entries.when: Text that flows endlessly along a curve; fancy/text-along-path already sets a moving marquee on an SVG arc or circle for a decorative header.

entries.name: Text Pressure
entries.when: Letters swell and squeeze under the pointer through a variable font; it needs a web font and a cursor, both forbidden, so use fancy/breathing-text for an ambient word.

entries.name: Text Type
entries.when: A typewriter with a blinking caret and adjustable cadence; fancy/typewriter (or arlan/typer when you need the erase) is the Kit's version for a headline or status line.

entries.name: True Focus
entries.when: A focus frame steps across a short phrase, sharpening one word at a time; a finite hero for a three or four word promise on a landing screen, never for copy people must read.

entries.name: Variable Proximity
entries.when: Letter weight and width bend toward the pointer through a variable font; no cursor in Messages and no web fonts under the CSP, so use fancy/breathing-text for an ambient word.

entries.name: Warp Text
entries.when: A WebGL pass bends and refracts a headline around the pointer; cursor-driven and non-lite, so leave it out; libraries/metal-fx is the one WebGL hero treatment the Kit allows.

entries.name: Shutter type
entries.when: Two lines of type seen through a rolling shutter: stripes lag the ink so a word tears into bands only while it moves and is whole at rest; one hero motion for a title card.

entries.name: Swing type
entries.when: Enormous coloured letters on a pendulum, each turning edge-on as it passes so only two or three read at once and the word never assembles; the word changes by turning.

entries.name: Rush type
entries.when: One lowercase word rests, then blasts twelve times taller and tears into green and violet streaks from speed alone, resolving to plain white at rest; the next word falls out of the blur.
